intro.name: Parker Allen
intro.role: I research, iterate on, and build visually pleasing apps that people enjoy using.
intro.copy: I'm a Creative Technology and Design student graduating in May 2027. I'm a detail-oriented, empathy-focused designer who pays attention to what's not working and provides thoughtful solutions. I mostly specialize in UI/UX design, UX research, graphic design, social media marketing, and front-end development.

portrait.alt: Parker Allen smiling outdoors in a denim jacket, in front of green and yellow leaves

intro.ethics: As a Learning Assistant for ATLAS’s Meaning of Information Technology course, I care about the ethics of technology and the media habits we build around it.

cards.title: Figma & prototyping
cards.body: Paper sketches first, then Figma prototypes that change as research findings come in.

cards.title: Front-end development
cards.body: Responsive, accessible interfaces in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with React on team and client sites.
cards.seen: Seen in Ouro Room, Hyperdrive

ai.title: How I use AI.
ai.intro: AI helps me build faster. It doesn’t replace research, judgment, or taste.

items.title: Building and debugging
items.body: I use coding assistants like Claude Code to scaffold, refactor, and debug front-end work, then review and test every change myself. This site and the Ouro Room redesign were built that way.

items.title: Research stays human
items.body: Interviews, synthesis, and design decisions come from real people. I don’t use AI to stand in for participants or to write findings.

items.title: Open about it
items.body: I say when work is AI-assisted, and I can walk through the decisions behind it.

items.title: Thinking about the impact
items.body: As a Learning Assistant for Meaning of Information Technology, I think about what AI means for privacy, creative work, and our media habits.
